scope: Independent source, exact artifact and preparation-boundary review. No Docker/WSL invocation, image operation, probe execution, installation, runtime qualification or GA.

checks.finding: main rejects run and formal at line 141 before reading config or calling prepare. The preparation module has no subprocess, shell, socket or network API call; it only constructs argument data and performs bounded local file operations. Importing probe defines functions but does not execute main.

Config permits exactly image and 32-hex run_key. Image must use the fixed python repository and sha256 form; no tag or implicit pull. Argv fixes pull=never, linux/amd64, uid/gid 10001, network=none, read-only rootfs, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, CPU/memory/swap/PID/log/tmpfs limits, no restart, fixed Python entry and fixed driver args. No environment, arbitrary command, mount or resource override is exposed.

CLI prepare derives a new run directory under this package's work root. Existing run evidence returns UNKNOWN. Ancestor symlinks/junctions and mount delimiters are rejected. Only the exact probe source read-only mount and that run's synthetic allowed directory writable mount are planned; no host home or Docker socket mount and no host env forwarding. This is a static plan; future supervisor must re-inspect actual resolved mounts and configuration before start. Image-inherited environment is explicitly unverified.

Before synthetic operations, main requires Linux uid 10001, no-new-privileges and zero effective/permitted capabilities; parent requires only loopback. It writes the allowed fixture, attempts a synthetic rootfs write and mode-zero canary read, runs a local TCP positive control, and tests a documentation-only TEST-NET destination. Timeout/refused connection cannot count as denial. The only process launch is the exact same Python driver descendant with empty env. These socket/process calls exist in the future probe, not in the preparer.

SIGTERM ignore is installed before the descendant publishes readiness. Parent waits within three seconds for complete JSON with exact typed PID/PPID/uid and true actual-handler marker, and still checks live child status; missing/partial/wrong-identity data cannot establish readiness. Future stopped predicate requires exact container ID, dict state, Running false, exact integer-zero PID, exited state and a valid nonzero timezone-bearing RFC3339 time. Neither helper is an actual Docker STOP observation.

Example image/run_key remain null; actual image digest, local inspection and isolation observations remain absent. Synthetic all-f digest is confined to parser tests. Local CreateNew/fsync/readback Intent remains explicitly distinct from remote durable Intent and formal idempotency. README accurately keeps inspect/create/start/live-child/STOP/wait/exact-ID inspection as future lifecycle work.

resolved_findings.problem: Descendant published readiness before installing SIGTERM ignore; parent relied on existence without a complete identity-bound record.
resolved_findings.resolution: Handler setup precedes ready publication; complete typed matching readiness is required in a bounded wait. Partial files are not success.

resolved_findings.problem: STOP predicate accepted garbage/empty finish timestamps and bool-as-integer zero PID.
resolved_findings.resolution: Typed state/PID and strict parsed timezone-bearing nonzero timestamp checks reject those false positives.

validation_reuse.original_nine_tests: Historical implementer run retained with original exact source hashes; not claimed rerun on the changed subject.
validation_reuse.targeted_fix_tests: Implementer recorded 5/5 pure-function/AST checks for the changed predicates. Reviewer read those exact tests and fixes; did not rerun them or the original nine.

qualification_not_established: No actual approved locally available image/runtime or engine security inspection.
No OS network/file/credential enforcement or live parent/descendant/container STOP result.
No implemented lifecycle supervisor with trusted exact-ID observation, current authorization/revocation, remote durable sink or actual budget reservation.
Credential canary absence alone is not non-inheritance proof; the future approved host control and image environment must be inspected.
Prepared flags and local guards do not establish race-free mounts, isolated host qualification, a complete accepted allowlist or production rights.
